claims.claim: Microservices let teams deploy and scale each service alone
This (independent deployment/scaling/updating) gives greater scalability and resilience
Independent deployment helps teams that need to ship frequently
Microservices can add significant operational complexity
You need a strategy for data consistency
Each service typically owns its own database
You can no longer rely on a single ACID transaction across the whole system
A team of fewer than ten engineers is often better off starting with a modular monolith
